name: Binnacle
description: Installs @it-bbox/binnacle from npm and starts its daemon with the container, its home on a volume of the container's own, accepting the host-side address once devcontainer.json publishes hostPort. Needs Node 24 or later.

version.description: The version of @it-bbox/binnacle to install from npm.

hostPort.description: The host port the container's 7717 is published or forwarded on: the daemon accepts 127.0.0.1 and localhost at it.
